decisions.reason: As a multi-model extension of the firm's core office systems that matches the shift toward flexible workplaces, it is likely still at or near aspiration and any weaker standalone visibility can be tolerated within existing organizational slack.

A chair family remains very close to the firm's established premium furnishing range, so absent clear failure boundedly rational management would usually retain it as part of a broad coordinated interior offer.

The floor cushions are a more peripheral niche line and, after several years without visible support, are more likely judged below aspiration and therefore released so resources can return to stronger core lines or new development.
The sofa was already the weakest-supported launch and continued low visibility suggests results below aspiration, making reallocation of attention and resources more likely than continued patience.

Although more distant from the legacy offer, the rug collection fits the firm's broader interior-solution direction and prior flagship status gives it strategic protection, so management would still be somewhat more likely to continue than to withdraw it.
